result.title: Earth embeddings are decomposable records of the land surface
result.summary: Ecological monitoring, carbon accounting and biodiversity assessment increasingly rely on annual Earth embeddings--learned vectors that compress a year of satellite observation for every ten-meter pixel on Earth, consumed in place of the imagery itself. What these vectors mean has not been established. Here we decompose two widely used embedding products and show that they contain individual ecological features, including fire, forest clearing and crop type, validated against independent reference data on events across six continents. The recovered concepts date abrupt canopy loss to the first post-disturbance growing season and resolve severity well enough to separate prescribed fire from wildfire. Small fires that recover quickly are detectable in one product but not the other, which instead separates crops more strongly.

AI.brief_summary: 论文探究「地球嵌入」（把一年卫星观测压缩为每个十米像素的向量）的实际含义，通过分解两个广泛使用的嵌入产品，并用六大洲的独立事件参考数据验证其包含火灾、森林砍伐、作物类型等可分离的生态特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 把冻结嵌入拆解为可命名的概念并以外部参考数据核验，这一思路可能对考察 LVR 内部状态是否保留任务必要视觉细节、以及如何评价 latent 内容提供借鉴；但研究对象是遥感表征而非多模态推理，联系较远。
